definitions.explanation: A small, unspecified number of books or bound volumes, typically implying two to five or so. Combines the prefix {数|すう}〜 (several) with the counter {冊|さつ} (for books).

examples.japanese: ⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{数冊|すうさつ}⟦{借|か}りて→借りる：00532_kariru⟧きた。
examples.english: I borrowed several books from the library.

examples.japanese: ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参考書|さんこうしょ}→参考書：05142_sankousho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{数冊|すうさつ}⟦{積|つ}まれていた→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
examples.english: Several reference books were piled on the desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、ガイドブック⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{数冊|すうさつ}⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧{下調|したしら}べ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Before going on the trip, I read several guidebooks to do some research.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (several/a few) and ⟦{冊|さつ}→〜冊：00666_satsu⟧ (counter for books/volumes). The prefix ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧〜 combines with many counters to express a small indefinite quantity: ⟦{数人|すうにん}→数人：18787_suunin⟧ (several people), ⟦{数回|すうかい}→数回：29820_suukai⟧ (several times), ⟦{数日|すうじつ}→数日：20517_suujitsu⟧ (several days), etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数冊|すうさつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本|ほん}: several books
- {数冊|すうさつ}⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have several books
- {数冊|すうさつ}⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to purchase several books

RELATED EXPRESSIONS WITH {数|すう}〜:
- ⟦{数人|すうにん}→数人：18787_suunin⟧: several people
- ⟦{数回|すうかい}→数回：29820_suukai⟧: several times
- ⟦{数日|すうじつ}→数日：20517_suujitsu⟧: several days
- ⟦{数台|すうだい}→数台：29815_suudai⟧: several machines/vehicles
